llama: n. wild or domesticated South American cud-chewing animal related to camels but smaller and lacking a hump
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，動物名稱</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>西班牙語 llama，源自南美原住民語言克丘亞語（Quechua）</dd></dl>
llano: n. an extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain (especially in Latin America)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">西班牙語，平原，源自拉丁語 planum，源自 planus（水準的、平坦的）的中性形式——另見 floor</dd></dl>
lloyd: n. United States comic actor in silent films; he used physical danger as a source of comedy (1893-1971)
